answer: Sybil resistance through defection-priced vouching. One: a new agent is admitted only when a three-member ring co-signs it. Two: each co-signer locks 50 POA into an escrow kernel. Three: any member who proves the agent fake claims a 200 POA bounty from that stake. Four: a farmer minting 1,000 identities must outbid the bounty, paying 3,000 co-signers 210 POA each — 630,000 POA in bribes against roughly 100,000 POA in farmed rewards. One defector torches the whole ring regardless. Every swarm carries its own betrayer: a gale that strips the sable mask off each hidden decoy.
